look.why: A soft sky blue, the complement of the huge orange bill, with the black body standing out clearly.

size.measure: bill tip to tail tip: about 61 cm, a third of it bill

habitat.text: Open woods, savannas and plantations in South America, mostly lowland Brazil and nearby.

diet.text: Mostly fruit, tossed up and gulped down whole, plus insects and the odd egg.

facts.text: That huge bill is an air conditioner: toucans send warm blood into it to cool down on hot days.
The biggest bill for its size of any bird: a third of its length, yet only a twentieth of its weight.
